note: Feature flags (22 §4, §6.5). Read at build time and by client islands. Unknown flags are OFF. Runtime override: env var FLAG_<NAME>=on|off in Cloudflare Pages. Every flag has an owner and a review date so flags don't pile up. V2.5: each flag has a 'launch' value, the value it must have in production at the public launch (D-068, FR-073). validate_feature_matrix.py checks that every shipping feature's flags launch ON, except the beta-only flags noindex_site and beta_banner and the privacy-gated suggest_email.

explore_goal.what: Explore-by tab: What do you want to do?

suggest_edit.what: Suggest an edit button + S36 on every page

suggest_email.what: Optional email field in S36. Keep OFF until the privacy notice is approved (D-027). Stays off at launch until D-027 approves the privacy notice.

beta_banner.what: Site-wide early-version banner linking to Suggest an edit

admin_report.what: A01 internal admin report (moved from R1.5 into R1 by D-068)

noindex_site.what: Private beta: whole site noindex + robots disallow. Turn OFF per journey at open beta.

helpers.what: Helpers: S39 index, S40 helper page (D-066)

helper_panel.what: S41 Helper panel shown on every page while a helper is active

helper_for_someone.what: Start a helper for someone else; share link and card (FR-072). Turn on once the card text is reviewed.

goals.what: Goals (S42, S43), goal search and 'Jump straight to a goal' on the home page (D-071)

alternatives.what: 'Other ways to do this' strip: up to 7 derived alternatives on goal and tool pages (D-072)

intent_chips.what: Compete / Grow / Scale chips on the home page (D-075)

stars.what: Star skills, tools, goals and helpers; three skill states; My workbench (D-079). Device-only until accounts are on

continue_card.what: 'Continue where you left off' card on the home page (FR-083)

suggestion_status.what: Suggestion status page /suggestions/{ref} (S48, FR-086) (default off in beta: needs accounts or server storage; turns on with them at Launch, V2.8)

outcome_prompt.what: 'What changed for you?' after a helper stage and 'Save what you made' (FR-084, FR-085) (default off in beta: needs accounts or server storage; turns on with them at Launch, V2.8)

accounts.what: Optional sign-in after value is shown, with sync (D-076). Off in the first beta weeks until Spike S-2 passes

recommendations.what: Rule-based 'next step' recommendations with a visible reason (D-080)

trending.what: Aggregate 'popular this week' lists (D-081). Hidden until the minimum-size rules in 24 §9 are met

tool_profiles.what: Tool description, price chip and Preview label on tool pages and cards (D-084). The Preview label cannot be switched off for unverified profiles

goal_safety.what: Safety panel on tagged goals and kit steps (D-087)

goal_search_natural.what: Natural-language goal search that strips lead-ins and ranks kits first (D-088)

suggested_for_you.what: Rules R9 to R12 for people who do not search; no account needed (D-089)

next_step_card.what: NextStepCard on every content page and Learn {tool} buttons (D-092)

need_feedback.what: Thumbs up or down on need cards (D-102)

helper_coachmark.what: Helper explainer banner, first-run coach mark, hide and restore (D-100)
